ruleDefinitions.name: AWL Bypass with Winrm.vbs and Malicious WsmPty.xsl/WsmTxt.xsl - File
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of attacker-controlled WsmPty.xsl or WsmTxt.xsl via winrm.vbs and copied cscript.exe (can be renamed)

sequences.query: (file_path = RGX("WsmPty\\\.xsl$") OR file_path = RGX("WsmTxt\\\.xsl$")) AND  NOT ((file_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\") OR file_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\SysWOW64\\\\")))
